summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the 4 new features on the Renewly static prototype (dark mode, swipe actions, savings tracker, family sharing). All 7 requested test scenarios pass end-to-end at mobile viewport 390x844. No functional bugs found. Known shadow* deprecation warnings on web are expected and can be ignored (already noted in agent context).

test_scenarios_verified.scenario: Swipe LEFT on sub-row-spotify reveals actions
test_scenarios_verified.result: PASS - pointer-event drag reveals swipe-snooze-spotify (amber) and swipe-cancel-spotify (red)
PASS - tapping Snooze shows snoozed-pill-spotify on the row; swiping again + tapping (Unsnooze label) removes the pill
PASS - savings-total ₹996 → ₹1,115 (delta +₹119 = 1 month of Spotify), hero-total ₹3,847 → ₹3,728 (delta -₹119), see-all count 8 → 7, Spotify row removed from Next up

PASS - hero ₹996 (seeded), Sony LIV +₹897 (3 months), Gaana Plus +₹99 (1 month), 'That's ₹4,776 a year back' correct; restore-sonyliv is absent (restorable=false), restore-spotify appears only for user-cancelled subs

PASS - nav-home/calendar/alerts/settings navigate correctly, savings-card routes to /savings, top-back returns

critical_code_review_comments: detail.tsx Charge history is hardcoded to Netflix figures (Aug ₹649 / Jul ₹649 / Jun ₹499 with 'price increased ₹150' chip) and is shown identically for every sub (e.g. Spotify shows Netflix's price change). Acceptable for a static prototype but flagging for awareness in case detail is intended to be sub-specific.
store.tsx line 12 and theme.ts line 67 both hardcode TODAY = 2026-09-16 in two places; consider extracting to a single constant to avoid drift.

app/home.tsx line 42/79 uses `router.push('/savings' as any)` - the `as any` cast suggests the Expo Router typed-routes definition doesn't include /savings; add it to the route types to remove the cast.
shadow* style prop deprecation warnings on web (react-native-web) — already acknowledged; migrate to boxShadow for cleaner console.
seed_data_creation: None - prototype uses in-memory state; only theme mode persists via AsyncStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Swipe actions on ReanimatedSwipeable do NOT fire with page.mouse.down/move/up on web — the row swallows the drag and treats it as a tap → navigation. Use JS-dispatched PointerEvent (pointerType='touch') via page.evaluate to correctly drive the gesture handler. See iteration_3 script for the exact snippet. All 4 new features verified working with correct math (savings deltas, hero total reduction, see-all count decrement) and correct testIDs in place.
